subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Explain quotes from world leaders and words like equality.
Listen for details and say them in my own words.
Talk about what it means to be a global citizen.

tf.s: 'Equality' means treating everyone the same and giving them the same rights.
The United Nations was created to encourage cooperation between countries.
tf.why: Correct, it helps countries work together.

tf.s: 'Diversity' means everyone is exactly the same.
tf.why: Diversity means many different people and cultures.

tf.s: A global citizen only cares about his or her own town.
tf.why: A global citizen cares about the whole world.

tf.s: A global citizen shows respect for other cultures.

tf.why: Cooperation means working together; revenge means hurting someone back.
Yes, 'Education is universal' means everyone should have it.

tf.s: A community is a group of people living together.
Protecting the environment is one way to be a global citizen.
tf.why: Right, it helps the whole planet.

tf.s: To rephrase means to copy the exact same words.
tf.why: Rephrasing means saying it in your own words.

boxes.why: The UN helps countries work together.

boxes.q: A person who guides a group is a…
A global citizen shows ___ for other cultures.
A group of people living together is a…
A good rule for a better world:
boxes.why: Equal treatment makes a fairer world.

hunt.q: Duty to do the right thing

o: a person who cares about the whole world
a person who travels every day
a person who only cares about one city

mcq.q: Why was the United Nations created?
mcq.why: The UN helps countries work together.
Universal things belong to all people.

mcq.q: Which word means 'treating everyone the same'?
Rephrase in your own words: 'Education is universal.'
mcq.why: Rephrasing keeps the meaning in new words.

mcq.q: Which is a good rule to make the world a better place?
Ali picks up rubbish at the beach and learns about other cultures. What is he being?
mcq.why: Caring for the planet and others is global citizenship.

mcq.q: Why does cooperation between countries help the world?
o: Countries can solve problems together instead of fighting.

mcq.q: Which answer gives an opinion supported by a reason?
o: Young people can change the world because they can protect the environment.
mcq.why: A strong opinion includes 'because' and a reason.

mcq.q: Why is respect for other cultures part of being a global citizen?
o: Because people of different cultures share one world.
Because all cultures are the same.
Because only one culture is important.
mcq.why: Respect helps diverse people live together.
